_schema.explanation:
This file contains the projects array. Each project object fields:
 - id: unique string id
 - title: project title
 - description: short 2-3 sentence summary
 - tech: array of tech tag strings
 - featured: boolean (if true, visually highlighted)
 - repo: GitHub repo URL
 - demo: optional live demo URL (null if none)
 - image: optional thumbnail URL (null if none)
_schema.note: Edit the array below to add or change projects. Keep the _schema property for guidance.

projects.title: Entrika — Reclaim your Digital Identity
projects.description: An application that allows users to exercise informed consent about their digital indentity by understanding how a company's terms of service and privacy policy impact their data and rights. Built with Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and vanilla JavaScript.

projects.title: Who is the Villain? — AI-Powered Social Game
projects.description: A fun social website where an AI judge evaluates participants's past questionable deeds. Built with Ruby on Rails and OpenAI's API, it demonstrates my backend skills and interest in AI integration.

projects.title: Trading Journal — My first Rails app
projects.description: A barebones trading journal app I built to learn Ruby on Rails. It allows users to log trades with details like entry/exit points, size, and notes. The project helped me grasp Rails fundamentals and MVC architecture.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: This portfolio itself — built with Vite, React and a static JSON content layer for easy updates.
